{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
assert 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "Premise failed: no 'new' customers in data"
assert 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(), "Premise failed: no 'paid_search' channel in data"

# Filter for new customers reached by paid_search
filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any such rows exist
assert len(filtered) > 0, "No rows match the population: new customers via paid_search"

# Inspect the filtered data
print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid_search: {len(filtered)}")
print(filtered[['converted']].describe())"}
